question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

Something that cannot be read clearly
solution:
The correct answer is: **Illegible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Illegible"** refers to something that cannot be read clearly, typically due to poor handwriting or text quality. (स्पष्ट रूप से न पढ़ा जा सकने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** His handwriting was so illegible that no one could understand what he had written.
 
 
 
• **"Legible"** is the opposite of "illegible," meaning something that is clear enough to be read. (पढ़ने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the student to write in a more legible manner to make the answers clear.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Illegible"** is correctly used to describe something that cannot be read clearly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Illegible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Decodable** (डिकोड करने योग्य): Something that can be decoded or understood.

 
 
• **Example:** The secret message was decodable only with a special key.
 
 
 
• **Invisible** (अदृश्य): Something that cannot be seen.
 
 
• **Example:** The microbes are invisible to the naked eye and require a microscope to be seen.
 
 
 
• **Unspoken** (अनकहा): Something that is not expressed in words but understood implicitly.
 
 
• **Example:** There was an unspoken agreement between the two friends to always support each other.
 
 

39:T69b,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
